welcome_messages.en: Welcome to AgriConnect! We're here to help you with agricultural information and support. How can we assist you today?
welcome_messages.sw: Karibu AgriConnect! Tuko hapa kukusaidia kwa taarifa na msaada wa kilimo. Tunaweza kukusaidiaje leo?

ticket_closed.en: Your conversation with the {officer_label} has concluded. Send a new message to start another conversation.
ticket_closed.sw: Mawasiliano yako na {officer_label} yamefungwa. Tuma ujumbe mpya kuendelea.

ticket_auto_closed.en: Your escalation could not be resolved because no {officer_label} was available. You can continue asking questions in this chat.
ticket_auto_closed.sw: Ombi lako la msaada halikuweza kushughulikiwa kwa sababu hakuna {officer_label} aliyepatikana. Unaweza kuendelea kuuliza maswali kwenye mazungumzo haya.
